MAP Call: [line_of_business:Opportunity Overview-Y6P] – [opportunity_type:Opportunity Overview-H1X] – [customer] – [opportunity_number] – [phase:Opportunity Overview-D3B] – [indication:8959b856-0f49-4c4e-8ec8-f5955320866a] – [bid_due_date:Opportunity Overview-T1U]

The MAP call will follow the agenda below. The majority of this call is designated for country/site validation and finalization. Please come prepared to support your data/output; all participants will represent the data they have gathered, as well as their analysis and interpretation, while also validating the proposed strategy.   ​

1.       Introduction, rollcall, background (TAL/TSL/Medic): Brief recap including Sponsor, phase, country considerations (must have or no-go countries) and sponsor considerations with a focus on any new information received since strategy and/or data planning calls. ​

2.       Analytics Lead Engagement (Feasibility and Site Analytics): Brief summary/presentation of the data and analysis for which team member is responsible throughout call: please, ensure to balance the content and allotted time.

3.       Enrollment simulation (TAL): Provided sufficient information is available before the call, the ASL will have a pre-populated model with known information from RFP specs and will facilitate this part of MAP call.  The TSL will guide the team to develop and finalize a viable, data-driven study strategy.
